name: League
sql:
CREATE TABLE "League" (
	league_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	season_year INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (league_id)
)

name: Manager
sql:
CREATE TABLE "Manager" (
	manager_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	experience_level INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	team_id INTEGER, 
	profile_id INTEGER, 
	transfers_made INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	successful_transfers INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	formation VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	matches_played INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	wins INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	draws INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	losses INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	total_rewards FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (manager_id), 
	UNIQUE (name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(team_id) REFERENCES "Team" (team_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(profile_id) REFERENCES "ManagerProfile" (profile_id)
)

name: ManagerProfile
sql:
CREATE TABLE "ManagerProfile" (
	profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	risk_aversion FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	financial_preference FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	youth_preference FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	aggression FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	patience FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (profile_id)
)

name: SeasonReport
sql:
CREATE TABLE "SeasonReport" (
	report_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	season_year INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	champion_team VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	report_data VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (report_id), 
	UNIQUE (season_year)
)

name: SimulationRun
sql:
CREATE TABLE "SimulationRun" (
	run_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	season_year INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	started_at VARCHAR, 
	finished_at VARCHAR, 
	heartbeat_at VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	render_mode VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	total_matches INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	matches_played INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cancel_requested BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	error_message VARCHAR, 
	metadata_json VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (run_id)
)

name: Team
sql:
CREATE TABLE "Team" (
	team_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	budget FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	weekly_budget FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	transfer_budget FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	wage_budget FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	manager_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (team_id), 
	UNIQUE (name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(manager_id) REFERENCES "Manager" (manager_id)
)

name: TransferReport
sql:
CREATE TABLE "TransferReport" (
	report_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	season_year INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	report_data VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (report_id), 
	UNIQUE (season_year)
)

name: Coach
sql:
CREATE TABLE "Coach" (
	coach_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	specialty VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	experience_level INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	team_id INTEGER, 
	learning_rate FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	exploration_rate FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (coach_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(team_id) REFERENCES "Team" (team_id)
)

name: LeagueTeams
sql:

	PRIMARY KEY (league_id, team_id, season_year), 
	FOREIGN KEY(league_id) REFERENCES "League" (league_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(team_id) REFERENCES "Team" (team_id)

name: Match
sql:
CREATE TABLE "Match" (
	match_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	simulation_run_id VARCHAR, 
	match_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	date VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	season_year INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	home_team_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	away_team_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	home_goals INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	away_goals INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	home_possession FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	away_possession FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	weather VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	intensity VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	home_passes_attempted INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	away_passes_attempted INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	home_passes_completed INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	away_passes_completed INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	home_fouls INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	away_fouls INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	home_corners INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	away_corners INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	home_offsides INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	away_offsides INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	home_yellow_cards INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	away_yellow_cards INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	home_red_cards INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	away_red_cards INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	home_injuries INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	away_injuries INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	trace_file VARCHAR, 
	video_url VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (match_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_match_run_season_number UNIQUE (simulation_run_id, season_year, match_number), 
	FOREIGN KEY(simulation_run_id) REFERENCES "SimulationRun" (run_id)
)

name: Player
sql:
CREATE TABLE "Player" (
	player_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	jersey_number INTEGER, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	age INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	position VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	team_id INTEGER, 
	potential INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	wage FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	contract_length INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	squad_role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (player_id), 
	UNIQUE (name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(team_id) REFERENCES "Team" (team_id)
)

name: TeamStatistics
sql:
CREATE TABLE "TeamStatistics" (

	wins INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	draws INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	losses INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	goals_for INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	goals_against INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (team_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(team_id) REFERENCES "Team" (team_id)
)

sql:
